query:
SELECT
            totp_secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL
                AND totp_enabled_at IS NULL AS "setup_pending!",
            totp_enabled_at IS NOT NULL AS "enabled!",
            (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM owner_recovery_codes
                WHERE owner_id = owner_accounts.id
                  AND used_at IS NULL
            ) AS "recovery_count!"
        FROM owner_accounts
        WHERE id = 1
          AND disabled_at IS NULL
